task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"OpenCode Go model provider for DeepSeek Harness - a maintained fork that keeps the model catalog reachable and configures itself from Settings > Models","id":"gh:1375429405","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-opencode-go-plus","slug":"DPH-1121/dsh-opencode-go-plus","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","model-provider","opencode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OpenCode Go model provider for DeepSeek Harness - a maintained fork that keeps the model catalog rea"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"chable and configures itself from Settings > Models"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-opencode-go-plus"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 OpenCode Go 订阅模型：自动带上网关要求的会话请求头，实时拉取模型目录并为新模型适配协议，在设置页配置 API Key、查看套餐剩余额度。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"本包是 `dsh-opencode-go` 的维护分支，修掉了「模型明明在网关目录里、却静默不出现在选择器」的几类问题。它与上游**不能同时安装**，升级时先卸载旧包。支持 dsh `0.1.6` /"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" `0.1.7` / `0.2.x`（含桌面版）。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"配置、迁移与排错细节见使用说明。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"见 **DSH 插件安装教程**。"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 兼容性"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"基线 **dsh `0.2.1-rc.5`**：清单通过 rc.5 的插件闸门、可装入隔离 profile 并 `--dump-config` 组合成功；插件只依赖 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" provider 注册面与网关模型目录，rc.3 → rc.5 未改动这两处（`dsh-llm-pi-ai`、`dsh-llm` 与 rc.3 逐字相同）。`engines.dsh` 同时保留 `0"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"面与网关模型目录，rc.3 → rc.5 未改动这两处（`dsh-llm-pi-ai`、`dsh-llm` 与 rc.3 逐字相同）。`engines.dsh` 同时保留 `0.1.6` 起的旧窗口。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 其他 DSH 插件"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- dsh-provider-plus —— 自定义模型提供商工作台：图片输入、网关请求头、模型拉取、连通性测试、用量查询。\n- dsh-wallhaven-wallpaper —— 在设置里搜 wa"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"llhaven，把图片铺成 Web GUI 背景。\n- dsh-plugins —— DSH 插件搜集面板：搜仓库、复制安装地址。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 许可"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"MIT。派生自 `Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go`，上游版权归各自作者所有。"}],"truncated":false}
